cost.value: szandite crystals worth a total value of 300,000 credits

description.value:
You transfer the colony mind ability from yourself and each secondary caster to your target: the entire network of the substance known as "szandite crystals," wherever they exist across the galaxy or on other planes. The material cost of this ritual is destroyed in the process of casting singlemind.

When you complete the ritual, if you are within planetary range of one of the Szandite Collective worlds, you lose the colony mind ability, becoming an individual with your own mind. Each of the required Swarm creatures must attempt a @Check[will|dc:28] save.

Success The secondary caster loses the colony mind ability, becoming an individual with their own mind.

Failure The secondary caster's mind is rejected by the szandite crystals. They lose their colony mind ability and become a mindless creature.

Critical Failure The secondary caster's mind is flooded with thoughts from the szandite crystal network and they instantly die.

As an additional effect of this ritual, all living non-colony mind creatures in the galaxy who have used szandite crystals to communicate at any point in their lives must attempt a @Check[will|dc:28] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature gains the colony mind ability. It shares this colony mind ability with all other creatures who gain a colony mind because of the singlemind ritual.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[7d10[mental]] damage. If it survives, the creature gains the colony mind ability (as success).

Critical Failure The creature's mind is flooded with thoughts from casters of the singlemind ritual, and they instantly die.
